plugin.note: Spiritual creatures task strategy: skip or block rangers; if killing, use Zamorak's Fortress for warriors and Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison for mages. Wear god-affiliated items for tolerance; Spiritual creatures are not cannonable or AFK-friendly.

requirements: 70 Strength and a hammer for Bandos spiritual creatures
70 Ranged and a crossbow that can fire a mithril grapple for Armadyl spiritual creatures
The Frozen Door miniquest plus 70 Strength, Hitpoints, Ranged, and Agility for Zaros spiritual creatures
mechanics: Spiritual creatures are only found in the God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.
Followers of each god are aggressive unless the player wears an item aligned to their god.
God item protection is effectively required because these are multicombat dungeons with many monsters.
Main God Wars Dungeon routing should include a Zamorak item and usually a Saradomin item.
Ancient Prison kills require a Zaros item inside; Saradomin and Zamorak items are still recommended for the route to the entrance.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon routing should include one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item.
Spiritual rangers are generally skipped or blocked.
Spiritual warriors are only recommended if killing them in Zamorak's Fortress.
Spiritual mages are recommended in Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison, especially for dragon boots.
Spiritual creatures are cannon-immune, not AFK-friendly, and give poor experience and drops relative to many similarly levelled monsters.

methods.label: Requirements and access
methods.summary: Confirm the assignment, Slayer, dungeon, and wing requirements before choosing a target.
recommendedFor: Players choosing between main dungeon, Ancient Prison, and Wilderness
Accounts deciding whether to block or skip
requiredOrKeyItems: Crossbow and mithril grapple for Armadyl area
The Frozen Door for Ancient Prison
steps: Confirm the task was assigned by Krystilia, Vannaka, Chaeldar, Nieve/Steve, or Duradel/Kuradal.
Confirm 63 Slayer for rangers, 68 Slayer for warriors, and 83 Slayer for mages.
Use main God Wars Dungeon for original Armadyl, Bandos, Saradomin, and Zamorak variants.
Use Ancient Prison only after The Frozen Door when targeting Zaros variants.
Use Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only when accepting level 28-32 Wilderness player-killer risk.
Do not bring a cannon; all Spiritual creature pages mark them cannon immune.
risks: Wrong god-item protection can make many nearby monsters aggressive at once.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon deaths can lose carried items.

methods.label: God item protection
methods.summary: Wear god-affiliated items so nearby followers become tolerant instead of aggressive.
recommendedFor: All God Wars Dungeon Spiritual creature kills
steps: In the main God Wars Dungeon, wear at least one Zamorak-affiliated item because Zamorak followers are found in all corners.
Add a second item for the god being targeted; this is usually Saradomin because Bandos and Armadyl spiritual creatures are rarely killed.
In the Ancient Prison, wear a Zaros-affiliated item inside.
Carry Saradomin and Zamorak protection while running to the Ancient Prison entrance.
In the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, plus one Saradomin item and one Zamorak item.
risks: Without god item tolerance, multicombat aggression can quickly become fatal.
Zamorak's Fortress drains all prayer points when entering.

methods.label: Target selection
methods.summary: Follow the task page's practical target guidance.
steps: Spiritual rangers are recommended to skip or block.
Spiritual warriors are only recommended if killing them in Zamorak's Fortress.
Spiritual mages are recommended in Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison.
Many players block the task because it is neither cannonable nor AFK-friendly.
Ironman players may unblock the task once they have 83 Slayer to get dragon boots from Spiritual mages.
notes: The task page says Armadyl and Bandos spiritual creatures are rarely killed.
Spiritual mages are the only Spiritual creatures that drop dragon boots.

methods.label: Zamorak Fortress warriors
methods.summary: Use Zamorak's Fortress when choosing to kill Spiritual warriors.
recommendedFor: Players choosing warriors despite the task's poor efficiency
steps: Enter Zamorak's Fortress only after accounting for the prayer drain on entry.
Use Zamorak and route protection items to prevent extra multicombat aggression.
Kill Zamorak spiritual warriors when choosing warriors; the task page recommends this area if killing warriors at all.
Use melee as the default style for non-Armadyl warriors.
Consider safespots made from piles of stones inside Zamorak's base when using Ranged or Magic.
risks: Entering Zamorak's Fortress drains all prayer points.
The task is low efficiency compared with many alternatives.

methods.label: Spiritual mages
methods.summary: Target Spiritual mages for dragon boots, usually in Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison.
recommendedFor: Players who choose not to block Spiritual creatures
steps: Use Spiritual mages if killing the task for dragon boots.
Prefer Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison according to the task page.
Protect or gear against Magic because all Spiritual mages use Magic attacks.
Treat Zamorakian Flames of Zamorak hits as Magic-drain risk.
Use Zarosian mages only when prepared for Ancient Magicks side effects.
risks: Zamorakian Flames of Zamorak drains Magic if it hits and deals damage.
Zarosian Ancient Magicks effects can poison, drain Attack, heal the mage, or freeze the player.

methods.label: Zaros Ancient Prison
methods.summary: Use Ancient Prison for Zaros variants only when prepared for stronger enemies and special attacks.
recommendedFor: Accounts with The Frozen Door complete
Players accepting harder variants for better Zaros mage drops
steps: Wear a Zaros item inside the Ancient Prison.
Use Saradomin and Zamorak protection while running to the entrance.
Expect Zaros spiritual creatures to be significantly stronger than the original four gods' variants.
Move away from Zarosian warrior smoke clouds that form an X around the player.
Dodge Zarosian ranger arrows that land on the player's position.
Expect Zarosian mage Ancient Magicks side effects even when prayer blocks the damage.
risks: Zarosian warrior smoke clouds can hit up to 40 damage and can hit safespotting players.
Zarosian ranger arrows can deal 35+ damage, disable overhead protection prayers, and bind the player.
Zarosian mage smoke, shadow, blood, and ice effects can poison, drain Attack, heal, or freeze.

methods.label: Wilderness God Wars
methods.summary: Only use the Wilderness dungeon when accepting PvP risk.
recommendedFor: Players intentionally using Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
steps: Use Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only when accepting level 28-32 Wilderness risk.
Bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item.
Use safespots where possible; the task page marks all Spiritual creature Wilderness rows as safespottable.
Do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.
risks: Player killers are the primary risk.
Multicombat monsters can interfere while escaping.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Plan supplies around god protection, route requirements, and low-value drops.
inventory: Prayer potions or restoration after Zamorak entry
Crossbow and mithril grapple for Armadyl
Looting bag only if using Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
steps: Bring the minimum number of god items needed to make nearby monsters tolerant.
Reserve inventory or worn slots for special access items such as hammer or mithril grapple.
Use Spiritual mages for dragon boots if the account needs them.
Do not expect strong profit outside dragon boots and Zarosian improved drop tables.
Keep Wilderness setups low-risk.

styleOptions.label: Zamorak warriors melee
styleOptions.summary: Melee Spiritual warriors in Zamorak's Fortress if choosing warriors.

styleOptions.label: Spiritual mages dragon boots
styleOptions.summary: Target Spiritual mages at 83 Slayer for dragon boots, using Zamorak's Fortress or Ancient Prison.

styleOptions.label: Zaros Ancient Prison
styleOptions.summary: Harder Zaros variants requiring The Frozen Door and Zaros protection.

styleOptions.label: Ranged or Magic safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use safespots with Ranged or Magic when appropriate, especially around Zamorak Fortress piles of stones.

body:
# Spiritual creatures

Task-page strategy for Spiritual creatures: most players skip or block. If killing, use Zamorak's Fortress for warriors or Zamorak's Fortress/Ancient Prison for mages, wear god items for tolerance, and target mages for dragon boots.
